Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
DerekCastor wrote:
> If i calling a vote and i have 1 pool and my prey play a Treachery,
> can i play Voter Captivation and save my *ss ?

No. Pool loss from Treachery is "when the results are tallied", before
the time Voter Cap can be played ("after a successful referendum").
